items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022

ctx.x: You’ve come a long way, baby.

Oh I will add one other anecdote, I’ll make you laugh. Okay? One of the — this is talking about getting outside the schools. When I was a young kid, my brother played clarinet and he played up through high school and then he became a police officer and detective and you know top, top, top cop. Anyway in those days you could do this, but my mom and aunts, depending on what year it was, would drive us around on Halloween to bars. And we would be in like a hobo outfit and we had this old hat that somebody got from…
Well now I know what you made on your first gig.
